info.title: LastDB ExeMem Cloud API
info.description: Fully typed design contract for cloud API v3. See docs/designs/cloud-api.md. nodeSignature for node traffic; githubOidc for DEV maintenance. No rules/settings; public read via grant#any (reader only).

post.description: Intents: mutations_since, snapshot (describe|part), file. Batch max 90; body ≤256 KiB; response ≤8 MiB. Under grant#any: any node key (registered/paid or not) may fetch; unknown-device 401 waived; rate-limited → 429 rate_limited / fetch.any (Decision 32).

401.description: Bad/expired/reused signature or unknown/revoked device (fields: request.signature|issued_at|nonce, device.id|revoked, account.node_key).

400.description: Invalid request / batch overflow (fields: batch.response, grants.any.role, …).

429.description: Public-read fetch rate limit; field fetch.any

post.description: Intents: mutations, snapshot (begin|commit), file (begin|commit). Node PUTs to storage between stages; commit verifies size/hash (Decision 33). No inline bytes; no storage-event confirmation. landed from grant; publisher always direct.

post.description: Intents: create, grant, revoke, access, delete. No rules. Public read: grantee any / role reader → grant#any. any+writer|submit → invalid_request / grants.any.role.

nodeSignature.name: X-LastDB-Signature
nodeSignature.description:
Ed25519 over POST
<path>
<protocol|->
<node key>
<device id>
<issued-at>
<nonce>
<body sha256 hex>. Companion headers required. Replaces LastDBNode bearer and X-API-Key.

githubOidc.description: GitHub Actions OIDC for DEV maintenance.

code.description: Closed error code set for v3.

field.description: Dot-path of the offending field, e.g. request.signature, grants.any.role

Hex64.description: Ed25519 public key or SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex)

OpaqueCursor.description: Opaque pagination / log cursor (wraps delivery_seq today). Max 256.
OpaqueCursor.title: OpaqueCursor

OpaquePartHandle.description: Opaque snapshot part / grant slot. Max 256.
OpaquePartHandle.title: OpaquePartHandle

PaymentUrl.description: Short-lived single-use signed payment page URL.

oneOf.description: Public-read grantee (grant#any). role must be reader.

GrantRole.description: writer → push lands direct; submit → proposal; reader → read only. grantee any: reader only.

StreamKind.description: Which log stream an entry belongs to / landed on.

node_public_key.description: Ed25519 public key or SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex)

IncorporatedFrom.description: Publisher re-append of an accepted proposal (EntryWire.incorporated_from).

payload_b64.description: URL-safe base64 envelope. Cap aligned with BODY_LIMIT 96 KiB decoded (contributions) / record limits.

accepted_at_ms.description: Unix ms when ExeMem accepted the entry.

restore_point_id.description: Optional snapshot_id (SHA-256 of Manifest). Omit for latest.

FetchSnapshotDescribeArgs.description: fetch/snapshot stage describe — snapshot/bytes action read.

through.description: Delivery seq covered by the snapshot (Manifest.through).

file_count.description: Number of files in the manifest.

name.description: Native DB name when present on Manifest.

part_handle.description: Opaque handle for a download grant page/slot (today offset index).

FetchSnapshotPartArgs.description: fetch/snapshot stage part — snapshot/bytes action download.

download_url.description: Presigned GET URL for this part.

headers.description: Header map for the GET (today grant.headers). Max 32 entries implied by page.

offset.description: Byte offset into the object (OBJECT_RANGE capped).

ciphertext_b64.description: Standard base64 ciphertext for this range.

entries.description: Writer device is X-LastDB-Device-Id (not in body).

PushMutationsArgs.description: push/mutations — mutation-log/append (direct or proposal by grant).

accepted.description: Empty when result was duplicate today.

duplicate.description: True when append was a duplicate (today result=duplicate).

path.description: Relative path within snapshot (≤512 B, ≤8 components).

upload_id.description: Optional; ExeMem may assign if omitted (today client sends Id).

PushSnapshotBeginResult.description: Client PUTs each file to upload_url (not this API).

name.description: Optional native DB name on Manifest.

file_handle.description: Optional opaque path; omit to let ExeMem assign.

sha256.description: Ed25519 public key or SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex)

name.description: Publication name (required for shareable today via spec).

ManageCreateArgs.description: manage/create — mutation-log/create-database. database_id is in the envelope.

grantees.description: Revoke any turns public read off.

ManageAccessArgs.description: manage/access — no mutation_id (Tom). Membership + public_read for caller.

role.description: Caller's relationship. public = reading via grant#any without a per-key grant. none = no access.

level.description: Effective write/read level. publisher → write. member from grant role. public → read.

public.description: Publisher only: true when grant#any is active. Members/public omit or false.

expires_at_ms.description: Optional capability expiry if ExeMem sets one (none on wire today).

ManageDeleteArgs.description: Publisher reclaim of all cloud data.

status.description: done = finished; accepted = async reclaim started.

expires_at_ms.description: Unix ms when the link expires.

AccountAddDeviceArgs.description: New device = header Device-Id; node-key signature for existing account.

device_id.description: Echo of the enrolled header device.
Device to remove from the bookkeeping list.

added_at_ms.description: When registered; omit if ExeMem has not stored it (not on wire today).

storage_used_bytes.description: Cloud bytes charged. Not on wire today — ExeMem must report.

released_bytes.description: Decimal string bytes released; nonzero only when complete.

FetchRequestBody.description: Single envelope or batch (max 90). One signature over whole body.

FetchResponseBody.description: Single envelope or batch (max 90). One signature over whole body.
